question: Which region has the highest average perceptions of corruption?
query: SELECT regional_indicator, AVG(perceptions_of_corruption) AS avg_corruption FROM world_happiness_report GROUP BY regional_indicator ORDER BY avg_corruption DESC LIMIT 1
raw_results:
| regional_indicator | avg_corruption |
| --- | --- |
| Central and Eastern Europe | 0.8709147957385894 |
answer: Based on the query results provided, Central and Eastern Europe has the highest average perceptions of corruption at approximately 0.871.
